pypi.author: Edgar Margffoy
pypi.summary: Pseudo terminal support for Windows from Python.

reviewed.note: The sdist carries a complete, PSF-signed Windows ARM64 Python swept in by its build (pythonarm64/, incl. Tools/scripts/umarshal.py - CPython's pure-Python marshal reader); the bundles install the wheel. pyproject.toml is the maturin build. No attestation: content review.
